version: 2026-11-01 pre-polish baseline, runtime-first.png; before three-heart revision
audience_segment: desktop novice creator; heuristic baseline, not human study

dimensions.name: State and goal clarity
dimensions.evidence: Observed screenshot: active Play/Edit, three-star goal, status line, keyboard hints; comprehension not human-tested.

dimensions.name: Agency and meaningful decisions
dimensions.evidence: Measured action/history tests and live-ai.json: edits change float, throwability, transformation and light response with shared validated transactions.

dimensions.name: Skill readability and mastery
dimensions.evidence: Inferred: initial low steps precede higher optional ledges; no human learning curve measured.

dimensions.name: Challenge calibration and fairness
dimensions.evidence: Observed by root keyboard route: original contact death punished navigation. Subsequent three-heart revision is separate from this baseline.

dimensions.name: Feedback and game feel
dimensions.evidence: Source inspection: coyote time, jump buffer, variable jump, tones and state feedback; no end-to-end latency or player confidence measurement.

dimensions.name: Pacing and attention rhythm
dimensions.evidence: Inferred: short continuous route, checkpoint and immediate editing reduce dead time; no session-duration distribution.

dimensions.name: Motivation
dimensions.evidence: Hypothesis only: optional discoveries and reversible creation support curiosity and autonomy. Enjoyment and repeat desire unmeasured.

dimensions.name: Accessibility and control comfort
dimensions.evidence: Observed screenshot/CSS: 7–10px secondary/control labels limit legibility. Keyboard alternatives exist; no remapping or touch game controls.

dimensions.name: Aesthetic-mechanic coherence
dimensions.evidence: Observed screenshot: original cohesive garden sprites, lit stars, readable terrain tops, expressive creatures; transformation state requires separate runtime evidence.
